create_NVILAForConditionalGeneration: create an NVILA multimodal model with vision tower, projector, and Qwen2 LLM for conditional generation
create_NVILAConfig: create an NVILAConfig with text and vision sub-configs for image and video token IDs
build_NVILAMultiModalProjector: build a multimodal projector that downsamples vision features and projects them to LLM hidden size
run_get_image_feature: run get_image_feature to process multimodal inputs through Siglip vision tower and merge dynamic scales
review_merge_features_for_dynamic_s2: review merge_features_for_dynamic_s2 to resize and concat vision features across multiple scales
